_note: Every runtime dependency of the client, with the reason it is here. check_dependencies.js refuses a package.json dependency that is not on this list, and a list entry package.json no longer names. Add a package by adding a sentence; a second component library, a floating-position helper or a toast kit is not a reason: bits-ui and the primitives are those.

motion: the spring and the interrupted transition the motion module uses where CSS transitions cannot be reversed mid-flight
